notes:
Account summary:
- Mid-market adtech company focused on realtime personalization and dynamic creative optimization.
- Primary technical lead: Eng Manager (K. Singh). Product lead: Head of Personalization (R. Mora).
- Requirements: low-50ms p99 for 1k rps embedding/rerank flow, VPC-only control plane, SOC2 + KMS + audit logs, model pinning and rollout policy, ability to run private inference on co-lo in 2026.
Engagement timeline (high level):
- 2025-11-03: Intro call (AE Jordan) - described Redwood hosted + dedicated options. Client interested in dedicated for latency guarantees.
- 2025-11-12: Technical demo + POC kickoff (SE Marina) - shared synthetic throughput tests, initial config for continuous batching. Fireflies id: ff_20251112_vermillion_poc_demo.
- 2025-12-01: Security questionnaire submitted; asked about on-prem agent and HSM/KMS integration.
- 2025-12-10: Pricing deck sent (drive link). Client pushed for committed price with burst.
- 2026-01-07: POC results: latency good in hosted env but customer measured infra overhead in their co-lo which increased tail latency. They flagged need for on-prem appliance or turnkey private agent.
- 2026-01-20: Finance flagged new hiring freeze/budget reforecast. Procurement delayed decision.
- 2026-02-02: Customer informs us they are evaluating Together (for private deployment + model registry) and Fireworks (for lower-cost dedicated) and Replicate (for quick embeddings).
- 2026-02-11: Final call - customer chooses split approach: Replicate for embeddings PoC immediately (cost) and Together for private/dedicated strategy long-term.
Loss reasons (direct quotes and paraphrase):
- "We like Redwood's performance but Together's on-prem agent and model registry map straight to our compliance timeline."
- "Replicate gave us a simpler billing/embeddings path to get experiments into prod faster."
- Price sensitivity + internal headcount change -> "we need a lower friction/cheaper path for Q1 experiments".
Playbook/notes for next cycles:
- Security asks: need clearer on-prem packaging roadmap and timeline; call out HSM/KMS workflows sooner.
- Pricing: provide mid-market reserved capacity templates with split commit + burst to compete with Replicate/Fireworks pricing model.
- Champion risk: single technical champion left for internal migration; escalate to Solutions Architect earlier to build multi-stakeholder support.
Open artifacts / follow-ups (post-closed):
- Add POC logs to internal win/loss doc (INF-4219).
- Send short survey to contact for feedback (do not spam).
- Mark as closed-lost in CRM; tag competitors: together, replicate, fireworks.
reason_lost: Chose competitive mix: Replicate for low-cost embeddings and Together for private/dedicated on-prem roadmap; budget freeze and lack of broad internal champion accelerated vendor selection.
win_loss_notes: Technical fit good but operational packaging and price/wiring favored competitors. Security timeline was decisive — Together promised faster on-prem agent + model registry integration aligned to their compliance window.
